title: Candidate dossiers from the 2026-09-26 lead vetting (5)
summary: Candidate dossiers created for the five leads that survived full vetting (toi-224-01, toi-2666-01, toi-3500-02, toi-6695-01, toi-7610-01); all remain Unverified leads — photometric evidence is exhausted and no independent epoch exists yet. Nothing has been submitted externally.
research_status: 5 Unverified leads · artifact audit per event · RV not tested

related.title: TESS single-transit tests: 76 TOI targets and 2 Gaia NSS companion checks
TESS periodic-candidate screen, batch colab-p01 (100 of 1,000 targets)

items.title: CYG-2026-09-TOI224.01 — TOI-224.01 (TIC given in the record)
items.description: Four deep, equal-depth, equally-shaped dips measured on the target in four separate TESS sectors form a single harmonic family with P = 31.5798 d (n = 23/58/81/91 from the reference): one period fits every observed event spacing, and the TOI table's own P = 705.5845 d is incommensurate with the observed train (705.58/31.58 = 22.34, non-integer). A grazing companion (Rp/R* = 0.28) on an M dwarf is favoured over a blended EB (no capable Gaia neighbour, on-target difference images in E1-E3); the period and the planet-vs-EB question are unresolved (RV not tested) — Unverified lead.

items.title: CYG-2026-09-TOI2666.01 — TOI-2666.01 (TIC given in the record)
items.description: Two deep, coincidentally-equal V-shaped dips on HD 80133 measured in S35 and S99, 1790.006 d apart, survive every artifact test run (on-target difference image 0.4 arcsec/0.7 sigma, shape ratio 1.02 +/- 0.02, 158-sigma red-noise significance, no capable neighbour). All short SPOC-DV periods (13.93/34.37/7.50 d) and the P 36.53 d alias are refuted as two-event artifacts and parity-inconsistent rows; 52 data-allowed aliases (P >= 12.79 d) remain. A grazing planet (Rp ~ 1.1-1.4 Rjup) or an equal-depth grazing EB is unresolved — RV is decisive — Unverified lead.

items.title: CYG-2026-09-TOI3500.02 — TOI-3500.02 (TIC given in the record)
items.description: Two clean on-target transits on TIC 443666343 (the S90 event E1 and the S64 reference; the S101 event E2 is an aperture-loss/pointing artifact, rejected): equal depth ~7.0-7.8 ppt, equal 7.9-h duration and shape, 36-47-sigma red-noise significance, difference images 0.3-0.4 arcsec on target, the 3.71-arcsec co-moving neighbour excluded by the deficit direction. Sixteen data-allowed aliases P = 700.6242/n (n = 2..18 excluding 18.44 d; P >= 35.03 d) — P = 350.312 d is the most economical single reading. RV and phase coverage untested — Unverified lead.

items.title: CYG-2026-09-TOI6695.01 — TOI-6695.01 (TIC given in the record)
items.description: Two clean equal-depth ~3.5 ppt transits (reference S34, E1 S61) on TIC 118339710, 723.995 d apart; the S88 event E2 is rejected (difference-image centroid 12.0 arcsec off at 14.7 sigma, POS_CORR2 -5.2 sigma). 26 data-allowed aliases of dT = 723.995 d (P >= 27.8 d by the review reading; shortest density-compatible 20.69 d per event). No <=4-sigma secondary at the covered aliases, no capable neighbour within the blend radius; RV untested — Unverified lead.

items.title: CYG-2026-09-TOI7610.01 — TOI-7610.01 (TIC given in the record)
items.description: One clean on-target transit in S99 (BJD 2461066.3486, depth 15,757 +/- 425 ppm, 3.76 h), 365.379 d from the S88 reference, equal depth and shape; no catalogued period fits (the TOI table's P 22.1441 d is not an integer sub-multiple of dT: 365.379/22.1441 = 16.5); 21 data-allowed aliases of dT = 365.379 d. A +5.9-sigma MOM_CENTR2 excursion is the residual caveat, no capable Gaia neighbour — Unverified lead.
